note: e2e test definitions (test() calls) in superdesk-client-core e2e/client/playwright over time. Points up to and including the last CLOSED month are frozen: reconstructed from git at each month start along develop's FIRST-PARENT mainline (use --first-parent, else a boundary can land on a feature-branch commit with a stale tree and show phantom dips). The trailing (in-progress) month is recomputed live by build.mjs on every CI build from the checked-out client-core develop tip (regex /(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])test\s*\(/g) and overwritten here, so it tracks merges within the month and freezes once the next month opens. The live counter runs ~1-3 below the original reconstruction, so a small method seam at the current month is expected. Growth/volume metric, distinct from the case burn-up.
